added_lines: catherine (kitty) rowland (nee o’keeffe), st bernard’s place; denise dingivan (nee boswell), bellview, clondulane; the annual november remembrance mass: for those who have died will be celebrated on friday 6th november in st patrick’s church at 7.30pm. families are invited to come along and remember their loved ones who have gone to their eternal reward. as in prior years, we will remember in a special way all those within the parish who died in the past 12 months, a representative of their families will be invited to this remembrance mass. first holy communion or confirmation in 2027 : parents who wish to enrol their child for first holy communion or confirmation in 2027 may now do so. our catholic primary schools have already circulated letters of information to relevant families, but if your child is home-schooled or attending a non-catholic school enrolling for a sacrament may be done through the fermoy parish website, under the heading of sacraments. fermoy parish newsletter: please submit all items to be included in the newsletter by 12 noon wednesday to the parish office. thank you. fermoy

25th october 2026 ~ 30th sunday in ordinary time masses for those who died during the year will take place in st mary’s church on thursday, 5th and friday, 6th of november at 7.30pm . special invitations to one of these masses are sent to the families who have been bereaved in the last year. all who wish to pray for the faithful departed are welcome to attend. mourneabbey parish: autumn station masses- a station mass for all local areas will be held at burnfort church at 7.30pm on thurs., 29th october. (thursday morning mass is cancelled that day). the autumn station mass at analeentha church will be at the 9.30am mass on friday 30th october. remembrance mass for those who died during the year will take place on friday, 13th november, 7.30pm at the church of st john the baptist, burnfort. november indulgences for the holy souls praying for the faithful departed who are in purgatory is a traditional feature of the church’s life. the month of november is the month when this is emphasised most of all. in the first week of november plenary (full) indulgences may be gained for the holy souls. indu lgences are the remission before god of the temporal punishment due to sins whose guilt has already been forg iven. the faithful christian who is duly disposed gains the indulgence under prescribed conditions for either himself of the departed. indulgences are granted through the ministry of the church which, as the dispenser of the grace of redemption, distributes the treasury of the merits of christ and the saints. ind ulgences for the holy souls may be gained in one of the following ways: 1. from 12 o’clock noon on 1 november until midnight on 2 nove mber, all who have confessed, received holy communion and prayed for the pope’s intentions (one our father and hail mary) can gain one plenary (full) indulgence for the dead by visiting a ch urch, and there reciting one our father and the apostle’s creed. confession may be made at any time within the week preceding or the week following 1 november. holy communion may be received on any day from 1 november to 8 november. 2. the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence applicable only to the holy souls once per day every day of november. the conditions mentioned above apply also for this. cemetery prayers in november st. gobnait’s; sunday 1st nov. at 3.00 p.m.(if weather prohibits, prayers will be said in st. mary’s church at 3st. joseph’s ; sunday 8th nov. at 3.00 p.m . (if weather prohibits, prayers will be said in st. mary’s church at 3st. mary’s; sunday 15th nov. after 11 a.m. mass (if weather prohibits, prayers will be said in st. mary’s church after 11 a.m mass.) cemetery prayers in mourneabbey parish burnfort cemetery; sunday 1st nov ., at 12.30 p.m . the abbey and ballinamona cemeteries; sunday 8th nov., at 12.30 p.m. and 1 p.m. mallow general hospital grounds; sunday 22nd november at 2.30 p.m. prayers will be recited around the cross at the back of the carpark. notices sunday 1st november is the solemnity of all saints – saturday evening and sunday morning masses as normal. mourneabbey parish – sunday morning masses as normal. monday 2nd nov., is all souls day – evening mass in church of the resurrection at 7.30pm. mourneabbey parish - evening mass in burnfort church at 7.30pm. southside tea/coffee morning – please come along for a cuppa and a chat after 9.15am mass (church of the resurrection) on wed., 28th oct., in the arches – a way to get to know our parish community (from mallow parish pastoral council). public rosary on sunday evenings for the month of october at muddy hill, grotto at 7.00pm. a special word of thanks to the legion of mary for the rosaries which were given to the first holy communion classes. month of the holy rosary, october, rosary in st. john the baptist church, burnfort - wed., 28th oct., at 7.15 p.m. mallow field club lecture – mallow gaa centre, tues., 27th oct., at 7.30pm. julie crowley will speak on “caregiving in conflict: the irish experience.” nurses and caregivers in casualty care 1914-1945. the parishes of mallow & mourneabbey
